description: Grant a Google Drive file or folder permission to an email address at a given role (reader, commenter, writer). No notification email is sent. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Grant Drive sharing access on one file or folder id to a single email address at exactly one role: reader for view, commenter for view and comment, or writer for edit. Returns the new permission id. An access-control write against Drive, and the grantee receives no notification mail.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with ok=true and the new permission_id.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm which email and role were granted on which file. This is an access-control change — be explicit that access was actually opened.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Grant Drive sharing access to an email address.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id/email/role, or role is not reader/commenter/writer. gsuite.not_found: the file id does not exist. gsuite.permission_denied: the connected account cannot share this file. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass role as one of reader/commenter/writer. gsuite.not_found: verify the file id. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
